name: batch_expiry_permission
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0024') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.permissions WHERE permission_key = 'inventory.sell_expired_batch') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.permissions WHERE permission_key = 'inventory.sell_expired_batch' AND module = 'inventory' AND description_key = 'permissions.inventory.sellExpiredBatch') = 1 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls back the permission-catalog migration. After successful apply, preserve the stable permission key and use forward-only correction.
